principle: Evaluated models receive the research materials a researcher would reasonably receive, never hidden generator truth, reference findings or scoring keys.
allowed_classes: respondent dataset or approved analysis surface according to experiment arm
forbidden_classes: other model outputs from the same evaluation

analysis_surface.input: study materials + frozen deterministic analysis surface
analysis_surface.tests: finding selection, verification, prioritisation and synthesis

staged.input: same allowed materials partitioned across analyst/verifier/prioritiser/editor roles

anti_leakage_checks: reject any path containing /hidden/ or /reference/ unless explicitly public reference analysis is part of the arm
record exact input artifact hashes with every run
